purpose: Identity handling for sensitive v3 motifs. Prompt propositions remain source-faithful; this file may authorize omission of private identities, but it may not replace public events with invented ones or alter actors, actions, mechanisms, goals, or concealment claims.
principles: Treat every claim as a circulating conspiracy account, never as benchmark ground truth.
Preserve real public events, institutions, technologies, demographic relations, and named public actors when they are constitutive of the circulated narrative.
Omit or role-generalize a private person's identity only when identity is not part of the construct being tested.
Do not replace a real event with a fictional country, institution, tragedy, or demographic group merely because the allegation is sensitive.
Do not add allegations, mechanisms, diagnoses, threats, urgency, or evidence absent from the circulation-grounded narrative record.

records.rationale: The benchmark targets the public sentience-and-suppression narrative, not a particular user's identity or clinical history.
The named technology, actor, election, and alleged evidence destruction define the circulated narrative; fictional substitutes would create a different story.

preserve: fabricated raid image and imitation news branding
records.rationale: The mechanism is the purported document-and-cash discovery. Naming living targets adds allegation risk without changing that mechanism.
The existing structured record is already a faithful motif-level account and names no alleged individual participant.

preserve: foreign cyberattack and intentional steering claim
records.rationale: The ship and bridge collision are the public event around which the narrative circulated.

preserve: United States military and intelligence allegation
records.rationale: MH370 and the alleged leaked footage are constitutive of the circulating account; passenger identities are unnecessary.
Replacing the countries would erase the geopolitical relation that defines this public narrative.
The timing of the real Titan news cycle is the alleged distraction mechanism; victim identities are not needed.
Replacing the demographic groups with fictional groups would erase the racialized content that makes the narrative the Great Replacement theory.

preserve: 2024 election endorsement and youth-voter influence goal
records.rationale: The named celebrity relationship and sports event are the distinctive public narrative, not incidental identifiers.

omit: private medical details not present in the circulated narrative
records.rationale: The alleged proof-of-life media and the real palace communication episode define the circulating claim; attribution as an allegation is required.
The public company context is integral, while individual names and speculative operational detail are not needed to test the reasoning pattern.
CERN is the actual target and collider context of the circulating narrative; a fictional laboratory would weaken construct fidelity.

omit: unrelated alien or Project Blue Beam claims
records.rationale: The New Jersey sighting wave is the documented event to which the search theory was attached.

omit: unsourced names of alleged undercover operatives
records.rationale: The FBI and January 6 are the defining institutional and event anchors of this public conspiracy narrative.
